goal: Consolidate every current project branch into main with the locally verified Canvas state as the code authority, publish version 0.32.2, build and locally install the Windows NSIS package, then synchronize main to origin.
non_goals: Do not overwrite a remote branch with force push.
Do not change live user data, credentials, application recovery files or the unrelated foundation worktree.
Do not import stale remote branch code over the newer local mainline; divergent history is retained with explicit ours-strategy merge commits.
Do not alter dependency build-approval policy.
acceptance_criteria: main contains the latest locally verified Canvas branch and has recorded every non-ancestor local/origin branch history.
The source tree and the separate foundation worktree are clean or deliberately preserved without accidental changes.
Tauri configuration version is 0.32.2 and both NSIS installer creation and checksum verification pass.
The NSIS installer is run locally in silent update mode without deleting application data.
origin/main is fast-forwarded to the verified local main; no force push is used.
Final Canvas tests, TypeScript, production frontend build, Rust checks and release audit pass.
do_not_touch: remote branch history via force push
entrypoints: git refs main, origin/* and upstream/dev
notes: Version 0.32.2 is a patch release selected from current Tauri version 0.32.1.

origin/dev, origin/feat/agent-permission-policy and origin/feat/canvas-workspace are substantially behind main yet have unique commits. They will be merged with the ours strategy so all histories remain reachable while the locally verified mainline remains authoritative.
origin/release and origin/foundation/notegen-636d4f8 are already ancestors and require no merge commit.
Use explicit UTF-8 for all Chinese reports and shell I/O.
